name: rc-players-wasm-smoke
description: The headless-browser smoke run over :rc-player-wasm:wasmPlayerTestDist. Kept out of the Gradle build on purpose (docs/design/RC_CMP_WASM_PLAYER.md): the bundle is a plain directory of static files, so all this needs is a static server and a browser, and npm only ever runs in CI on a directory that is already assembled.
